verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Asana exposing itself as an MCP server (asana-probe-3) so external agents can call Asana's tools, and Asana's own AI Teammates/Agents features (asana-docs-5,6,12,13) with no mention of those agents consuming external MCP servers' tools. There is no documentation of Asana acting as an MCP client that plugs into third-party MCP servers.
